info.name: Amazon Clean Rooms Collaborations Protected Queries API
Amazon Clean Rooms List Protected Queries

params.name: membershipIdentifier
params.description: The identifier for a membership resource.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: The token value retrieved from a previous paginated request.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of protected queries to return.

params.name: status
params.description: A filter for the status of the protected query.

items.docs: Lists protected queries, sorted by the most recent query.

info.name: Amazon Clean Rooms Start a Protected Query

params.name: membershipIdentifier
params.description: A unique identifier for the membership to run the protected query.

items.docs: Creates a protected query that is started by AWS Clean Rooms. A protected query enables analysis on configured tables without exposing underlying raw data.
